Method of Attack: Credential phishing via emails impersonating Bank of America, directing targets to a phishing page resembling the Bank of America home page to steal account credentials and security challenge questions
Use of zero-day link and look alike website with a newly registered domain and valid SSL certificate to bypass security databases and scan engines
Social engineering inducing urgency by asking users to update their bank email account to avoid recycling
Impacted Systems: Outlook inboxes of targeted organization users
Attack Vector: Phishing email sent from a personal Yahoo account via SendGrid, passing SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authentication checks
Targeted low-volume email campaign to evade detection by Secure Email Gateway and Microsoft email security
Indicators of Compromise: Use of SendGrid for email delivery
